notes: Seed www.brazosvotes.org redirects to elections.brazoscountytx.gov. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Results page posts Hart-style Cumulative Results Reports (county totals) as 'Unofficial' and 'Official'. Files for elections before May 2026 were re-uploaded in April 2026 as ADA 'accessible' versions (wp-content/uploads/2026/04), so they carry no election-night upload time. 2026 primary: besides the unofficial cumulative (Run Time 9:28 PM 3/3/2026), per-location 'Precinct Report 3-3-26' files are posted, but only as April 2026 re-uploads, so whether precinct numbers appeared on election night cannot be decided; check 3 pending. 2024 general: the only unofficial file is a cumulative report run 10:15 AM Nov 6 and no precinct-level report is posted. 2026 runoff: unofficial cumulative county totals run 9:09 PM and uploaded 10:15 PM CDT; no precinct report posted.
tag_rationale: 2024 general and 2026 runoff are both LATER (county totals only, no precinct numbers posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because the 2024 evidence has no election-night upload time.

2024_general.fact: 'Nov. 5, 2024 General and Special Elections - Cumulative Results Report (Unofficial)' = 'Cumulative Results Report Brazos County Unofficial Results 2024 November 5th General and Special Elections ... Precincts Reporting 125 of 125 = 100.00% Run Time 10:15 AM' (county totals); re-uploaded Tue, 07 Apr 2026. Other 2024 general files are Official Cumulative and reconciliations; no precinct-level report is posted.

2026_primary.fact: Unofficial Cumulative Results Report Run Time 9:28 PM 3/3/2026 (county totals) and per-location 'Precinct Report 3-3-26' PDFs are posted, all re-uploaded April 2026 (Last-Modified Mon, 06 Apr 2026), so election-night publication of precinct numbers cannot be decided. Check 3 pending.

Precincts Reporting 79 of 79 = 100.00% Run Time 9:09 PM 5/26/2026' (county totals); Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 03:15:57 GMT. Only other runoff results file is 'Cumulative Results (Official)'; no precinct report.
